newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Leading Spirit Conrowa offers 393 mln shrs in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Leading Spirit Conrowa offers 393 mln shrs in IPO.

text.p: Leading Spirit Conrowa Electric Co Ltd (LSC), a spinoff of Leading Spirit (Holdings) Co Ltd, said it is issuing 393.12 million shares at HK$1.00 each in an initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong.
The issue price will represent a price/earnings multiple of 7.8 times on a fully-diluted basis.
The annual dividend yield is 5.8 percent and the adjusted net tangible asset value per share is HK$0.834.
Twenty percent of the issue will be offered to Leading Spirit's existing shareholders, 10 percent will be reserved for employees and the balance will be for public subscription.

A preferential offer to existing Leading Spirit shareholders will be in the proportion of one LSC share for every 50 Leading Spirit shares held and one free LSC warrant for every 30 Leading Spirit shares held.
The Hong Kong IPO will run from June 11-17 and dealing in the shares is expected to begin on June 26.
China Development Finance Co (HK) Ltd, Yuanta Securities (Hong Kong) Co Ltd and Amsteel Corporate Finance (HK) Ltd are the sponsors of the issue.
LSC said net proceeds would be used to fund construction of a factory and to buy equipment and facilities for the plant.
The proceeds will also be used to establish outlets in China, with the balance for working capital, it said.

LSC, which has a distribution network of more than 330 specialty shops in China, is engaged in the design, manufacture, assembly and sale of electrical home appliances such as television sets, washing machines and air-conditioners.
It also trades parts and components for the manufacture of home appliances.
LSC forecast its profit to be not less than HK$168 million for the year ending in June 1997. It gave no comparative figures.
